edits.old: | Avoid AI overconfidence in proposed actions | Open Practice Library | `open-practice-library-aar.md` | Open Practice Library's Evals practice (against AI overconfidence) and Human-in-the-Loop (against silent AI delegation) are the action-discipline cues. |

edits.old: | Mark delayed retraining as visible and timed | US Army, TC 25-20 | `tc-25-20-army-aar-aar.md` | If the next action is deferred, the deferral must be visible and timed, not silent. |
